description: Re-send the LIVE eBay listing of up to 25 products from each product as it is now — title, description, photos, item specifics, condition, price, quantity and business policies — without ending the sale. Use after a listed product was corrected (update_product, upsert_product_translation, upsert_product_attributes, upsert_product_prices, set_channel_texts) and eBay should show it; a draft goes through publish_ebay_drafts instead, and the listing's eBay category never changes here (recreate_ebay_drafts does that). Every go-live gate runs again, so a missing required specific is named rather than left for eBay; a product whose eBay sync is paused is refused. Needs the owner's AI publishing switch and an armed listingCreate direction. eBay allows 250 revisions per listing a day. Returns done, failed (named, with reasons) and notAttempted. The result echoes the workspace.

productIds.description: Re-send each product's LIVE eBay listing from the product as it is now, at most 25 ids fetched with search_products. The sale continues; a draft (publish_ebay_drafts) or a product with no listing is refused by name.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
